items.title: Another Bitcoin Mining Firm Flags 'Hashrate Hijacking' Attacks That Reroute Rewards
items.summary: Braiins says an attacker exploited the unencrypted Stratum V1 protocol and internet route hijacking to impersonate mining pools, striking over 1,000 sites in a single second.

items.title: Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor
items.summary: Rep. Nick Begich's bill to write the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law, with a 20-year ban on selling its bitcoin, is now eligible for a House floor vote. This post Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Fidelity files for spot Chainlink ETF with planned Nasdaq listing

items.title: Nvidia to Pay $290 Million to Settle Long-Running Crypto Mining Revenue Lawsuit
items.summary: The proposed cash settlement would resolve a shareholder suit alleging the chipmaker hid how much of its 2017-2018 gaming revenue came from crypto miners.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Struggles Below $60K as Spot Buyers Retreat and Leverage Builds
items.summary: Bitcoin fell for a second consecutive day Wednesday, hitting an intraday low of $57,209 amid renewed U.S. tariff war fears. The sell-off pushed cryptocurrency liquidations to $579 million, while bitcoin remained down by nearly 25% since the start of November.
